svg.text: Roux builds on top of standalone Clog crates (clog-*). Thread-per-core Tokio (current_thread + LocalSet), Linux io-uring in clog-wal.
Grain interfaces and grain implementations (source-generated proxies and invokers · explicit NodeBuilder registration)
Durable owner-placed activations · reentrant single-threaded turns · at-most-once calls · Drop-only volatile cleanup
Nil-externality: messages release only after Clog journal durability · ledger-replica lease checks · timers · Value/Map/List/Queue/Set/Inbox/Outbox
Durable jobs: partitioned scheduler grains backed by ordinary Clog journals
Rapid cut detection (Probe) and Fast Paxos · durable views in clog-metastore · 0 defunct retained · stall-only LocalHealth
Ephemeral MemberId liveness, endpoints, and failure-drain hints to clog-ledgers (no leases; leases live in L2 Clog)
clog-journals: per-key Append/Replace, JournalVersion CAS, CRC-32C, pluggable RoutingKey || JournalKey, WAL-less lsm-tree
clog-ledgers: dyadic KeyRange ledger-map, zero-copy splits/merges/rolls, LedgerQuorum (N=3/Q=2), ClusterController
clog-archive (concrete SlateDB LSM, single instance) · clog-wal (CLFL io_uring/std::fs + LedgerStore CLSC/CLSI)
roux-storage: Roux Messaging adapters (CASPaxos, Replica, Forward, Cluster/NodeControl) · per-thread JournalClient
Membership-free RPC between processes (InstanceId + TCP/rustls) · one connection per peer per direction
Single Frame enum · Service | Object targets · standard bytes::Bytes · High/Normal priority lanes
Cloud object storage (object_store) · local NVMe (Linux io-uring WAL + lsm-tree; std::fs dev) · tokio::net TCP/rustls
RPITIT + Send + dedicated I/O for Clog
Safety split: Clog guarantees durable safety unconditionally (ledger seals, MetaStore CAS, JournalVersion admission).
Each open ledger also carries a quorum-intersecting replica lease (ST8) to bound dual activations for non-durable effects, plus cooperative drain on handoffs.
Crate DAG: clog-* depends on nothing in Roux; roux-storage wires Clog onto roux-net and feeds roux-membership liveness hints.
